body:
I reproduced the same outer-probability issue in the two varlen backward kernels, which this PR currently leaves unchanged.

In `_flash_attn_bwd_varlen_dq_fused` and `_flash_attn_bwd_varlen_dkv`, the softmax derivative needs the undropped outer `P`:

```python
dS = P * (dropout_backward(dP) - D)
dV = P_drop.T @ dO
```

Keeping a separate `P_drop` for dV fixes the varlen case without changing your dense correction. On current master (`714859074`), my eight FP16/BF16 same-mask varlen tests give four failures before the change and all eight pass afterward. They include nonzero Q/K/V and compare dQ/dK against FP64 autograd; they do not check cross-implementation RNG compatibility.

I am preparing a varlen-only follow-up so the changes do not overlap this PR.
